items.name: Dirt
items.description: Soft and plentiful.

items.name: Stone
items.description: The bones of the world.

items.name: Sand
items.description: Falls when nothing holds it up.

items.name: Clay
items.description: Dense, red earth.

items.name: Wood
items.description: Sawn boards. Builds almost anything.

items.name: Stone Bricks
items.description: Dressed stone.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.description: Smelt three at a furnace for a bar.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Smelt three at a furnace for a bar.

items.name: Wood Platform
items.description: Stand on it, jump through it. Hold down to drop.

items.name: Wood Wall
items.description: A backdrop of boards. Keeps the sky out.

items.name: Stone Brick Wall
items.description: A backdrop of masonry.

items.name: Torch
items.description: Push back the dark.

items.name: Gravel
items.description: Loose stones. Falls like sand.

items.name: Obsidian
items.description: Where water met fire. Needs an iron pickaxe.

items.name: Glowcap
items.description: A mushroom that glows blue in the dark.

items.name: Bucket
items.description: Scoops up a full tile of water or lava.

items.name: Water Bucket
items.description: Pours out a tile of water.

items.name: Lava Bucket
items.description: Pours out a tile of lava. Careful.

items.name: Copper Bar
items.description: Soft metal, easy to work.

items.name: Iron Bar
items.description: Hard metal for better tools.

items.name: Workbench
items.description: Crafting station. Most things start here.

items.name: Furnace
items.description: Crafting station. Smelts ore into bars.

items.name: Anvil
items.description: Crafting station. Forges metal tools and weapons.

items.name: Table
items.description: Something to put things on.

items.name: Chair
items.description: Sit down for a while.

items.name: Chest
items.description: Stores 30 stacks. Right-click to open.

items.name: Door
items.description: Right-click to open and close. Blocks the way when shut.

items.name: Bed
items.description: Right-click to make it your respawn point.

items.name: Copper Pickaxe
items.description: Bites through dirt, stone and common ore.

items.name: Iron Pickaxe
items.description: Strong enough for the glowing ore of the caverns.

items.name: Copper Axe
items.description: Fells trees for wood.

items.name: Iron Axe
items.description: Fells trees quickly.

items.name: Wooden Hammer
items.description: Shapes blocks into slopes and half blocks. Knocks down walls.

items.name: Snow
items.description: Packed and cold.

items.name: Ice
items.description: Clear, hard and slick.

items.name: Sandstone
items.description: Sand pressed into stripes of stone.

items.name: Sandstone Bricks
items.description: Warm, dressed desert stone.

items.name: Ash
items.description: Grey dust of the Emberdeep.

items.name: Basalt
items.description: Dark rock from far below.

items.name: Obsidian Bricks
items.description: Glassy and nearly unbreakable.

items.name: Lumite Ore
items.description: Glows faintly. Needs an iron pickaxe.

items.name: Cinderite Ore
items.description: Still warm. Needs a lumite pickaxe.

items.name: Lumite Bar
items.description: Light, strong, softly glowing metal.

items.name: Cinderite Bar
items.description: Metal forged in the deep fire.

items.name: Cactus
items.description: Prickly pulp from the dunes.

items.name: Sandstone Wall
items.description: A striped desert backdrop.

items.name: Copper Shortsword
items.description: Quick jabs. Point it where you want it.

items.name: Iron Broadsword
items.description: A wide overhead arc that sends things flying.

items.name: Wooden Bow
items.description: Shoots wooden arrows. Aim a little high.

items.name: Wooden Arrow
items.description: Ammunition for bows.

items.name: Lumite Glaive
items.description: A long glowing blade on a pole. Keeps trouble at arm's length.

items.name: Ember Staff
items.description: Hurls a fireball that bursts on impact and lights the way.

items.name: Lumite Pickaxe
items.description: Cuts through cinderite and anything softer.

items.name: Cinderite Pickaxe
items.description: Hot to the touch, and nothing holds against it.

items.name: Gloop Gel
items.description: Sticky and faintly sweet. Burns well.

items.name: Bat Wing
items.description: Leathery and light.

items.name: Husk Cloth
items.description: Rags from something that walked at night.

items.name: Ember Core
items.description: A heart of living fire from the Emberdeep.

items.name: Glowcap Brew
items.description: Restores 50 life. Tastes blue.

items.name: Heartroot
items.description: Eat it to raise your maximum life by 20 (up to 200).
